quality.title: Pre-dispatch photos
quality.intro: Optional. Share photos of the goods before you dispatch. An automatic check compares them with the order and keeps the result as advisory evidence in case of a dispute. It is not an approval and never blocks dispatch or payment.
quality.limitReached: You have shared the maximum number of photo sets for this order.
quality.onlyBeforeDispatch: Photos can only be shared before or at dispatch.
quality.pendingRefresh: Analysing your photos. This page updates automatically.
quality.privacy: Location and camera details are removed from photos before they are stored. Photos are private and deleted after 6 months.

errors.format: Use JPEG, PNG or WebP photos.
